description: Machine-readable ontology of AI-writing patterns. Isomorphic to the OWL model: WritingSample, TextUnit (Paragraph/Sentence/Token), FeatureFamily, FeatureType, FeatureMeasurement, FamilyScore, DetectionResult.

ProbabilisticFeatures.description: Corpus-level predictability and uniformity: entropy, burstiness, lexical diversity, repetition.

LexicalPatterns.description: Vocabulary choices: overindexed buzzwords, credibility-padding phrases, function-word behaviour.

SyntacticPatterns.description: Sentence structure: length uniformity, complexity, structural templates, tricolon lists.

DiscoursePatterns.description: Paragraph/document organisation: mechanical transitions, blocky symmetry, resolution closers.

EpistemicStance.description: Claim positioning: hedging, depersonalised neutral voice, importance meta-commentary.

FormattingPatterns.description: Typography and layout fingerprints: em dashes, curly quotes, markdown tics, contraction balance.

PragmaticDepth.description: Content behaviour: entity/example specificity vs generic abstract synthesis.
